title: Config-aware regression gate with staged traffic mirroring and automated revert
creator: Daniel Kim
description:
Goal: Add a config-aware quality gate that evaluates model/config changes during staged deployments (mirrors + canary/A-B traffic) and triggers automated rollback or mitigation when predefined quality regressions are detected. This ticket scopes the core controller, evaluation pipeline integration, and the safety policy DSL for config-scoped thresholds.

Motivation: We frequently deploy model variants and runtime config flips (quantization profiles, KV cache toggles, batching heuristics). Some changes cause subtle quality regressions that only appear on production distributions. We need a low-friction, observable gate that: (1) continually measures a small, stable sample of traffic against golden prompt sets and production-sampled prompts, (2) evaluates multiple quality signals (semantic similarity, hallucination rate, function/format correctness, latency impact), and (3) takes automated remediation actions (scale back percentage, revert config, mute rollout) if drift exceeds thresholds.

Design summary:
- Controller: rollout-sentinel microservice that subscribes to rollout events (canary start, A/B split) and attaches an eval job to each cohort.
- Traffic modes: support 1) mirrored probes (0% of user-visible traffic, full inference executed but response discarded) for sample collection and 2) graduated canary percentages (1%, 5%, 25%).
- Eval engine: reuse existing online-evals pipeline but add a config-scoped comparator that compares baseline cohort vs candidate on the same input set, producing delta metrics with confidence intervals. Metrics include: aggregated quality_score (weighted), hallucination_rate, exact-match on extraction tasks, end-to-end latency P50/P95, and token-level perplexity.
- Policy DSL: simple YAML policy attached to rollout configs with rules like "if delta.quality_score <= -3.0 and p<0.01 OR delta.hallucination_rate >= +2.5% then action: automatic_revert, notify: oncall, preserve: debug-traces". Policies can be overridden per-customer for Dedicated/Private.
- Actions: pause rollout, revert to pinned config, route traffic off candidate, and create an incident with collected traces and golden-set failures.

Instrumentation and observability:
- Console: new rollout-gates dashboard that surfaces per-cohort metrics, top failed prompts, diffs, and confidence intervals. Link to runbook and rollback button.
- Logs/Traces: collect request/response diffs for sampled failures to S3 with access control; attach to PR and incident.
- Alerts: Slack + PagerDuty integration for P0 regressions as defined by policy.

Failure modes and mitigations:
- False positives due to small sample variance: require minimum sample size or Bayesian smoothing before triggering auto-revert.
- Metric degradation due to unrelated infra regressions: cross-check latency regressions against infra SLOs and require model-quality delta to be present.
- Sensitive customer data in mirrored probes: strip PII in mirrored payloads by default; flag Dedicated deployments where mirroring is disabled unless explicitly approved.

Implementation plan (phased):
1) Phase 1 (this ticket): implement controller and policy DSL + mirrored probe collection and a lightweight comparator for the golden prompt set. Wire basic auto-revert action for 1% canaries.
2) Phase 2: extend comparator to online production-sampled inputs, add confidence interval calc, integrate with rollout console and alerts, and support A/B metrics aggregation.
3) Phase 3: tuning and per-customer policies, performance optimization, and GA.

Acceptance criteria (see field): controller exists and is running in staging; mirrored probe pipeline returns diffs for golden set; automatic_revert action successfully reverts a synthetic canary in staging with audit log entry; rollout console displays gate results for staged deployment and exposes manual override.

References and artifacts: Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Config-Aware-Regression-Gate; initial design notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KRD-example; prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6254; e2e test run (staging): https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/rollouts/staging-evals?orgId=1
acceptance_criteria: Rollout-sentinel service deployed to staging and subscribes to rollout events
Mirrored probe collector executes candidate model on golden prompt set and stores diffs
Policy DSL applied to a staging canary and triggers automatic_revert for synthetic failing condition
Rollout console surfaces gate metrics, failed prompt samples, and manual override
Audit log entry created for any automatic action with links to PRs and traces
comments: 2025-02-15 - Daniel Kim: Created initial spec after post-mortem on production regression. Key ask: reduce time-to-detect regressions to under 10 minutes for small canaries.
2025-02-20 - Asha Patel: Design review completed. Agreed to use Bayesian smoothing to avoid noisy auto-reverts. Decided mirrored probes must default to PII-scrubbing.
2025-02-24 - Eng infra: Prototype PR submitted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6254. Includes basic sentinel and golden-set comparator. Needs test harness and more metrics.

2025-02-27 - QA: End-to-end staging test run shows comparator delta detection on synthetic hallucination injection (delta.quality_score = -4.8, p<0.001). Auto-revert executed successfully against synthetic canary. Logs and traces archived: s3://redwood-eval-archives/staging/ENG-118234/

2025-03-02 - Observability: Dashboards prototype available at https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/rollouts/staging-evals. Early feedback: add top-10 failed prompts and confidence bands; paging UI needs permission controls.

2025-03-04 - Asha Patel: Working on integrating production-sampled inputs and confidence interval calc. Blocking: stable sampling key from router team (dependency ENG-41258) and authorization for mirrored payloads in Dedicated accounts.
Next steps: finish comparator improvements, add policy editor in console, and write canary e2e tests to cover edge cases; coordinate with Security for Dedicated mirroring exceptions.
